verdict.rationale: Notion's own marketing and docs point to Custom Agents that 'keep work moving 24/7' and to Notion Skills, which are pages holding instructions for a repeatable workflow. Both suggest no-code, agent-driven automation, but nothing documents a multi-step automation builder. The REST API, webhooks and personal access tokens are developer building blocks, and the integrations directory covers third-party connections, so neither earns credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of a no-code multi-step automation or workflow builder (triggers, chained actions, conditions), evidence of how product managers configure Custom Agents without code, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build multi-step automations without writing code

citations.quote: Find the Custom Agents your token can access, track their usage, and manage their status and credit limits.
